thread:
Lina: heads-up: we should surface why requests jump between capacity tiers in Console. support wants auth-origin visibility.
Omar: agreed. we need per-request attribution so billing and routing teams can trace regressions.
Priya: idea: add an internal header `x-rwd-auth-origin` from the auth resolver with values like ORG, PROJECT, SA and a hashed id `x-rwd-auth-hash`. internal only.
Jun: implementation note: add at the auth-proxy to avoid extra hops. keep emission sampled initially (0.2%).
Alex: metric plan: emit `routing.auth_origin.tokens` counter with labels origin_bucket, model, region. sampled and limited to top-100 origin buckets.
Lina: Console UX: add a small "Auth origin" breakdown on route page and a global filter. also an "Explain" panel that shows the auth decision path and link to trace.
Omar: ops: ensure no PII leaks. hash SA emails and redact raw org ids in metric labels. full mapping only in secure traces.
Priya: rollout: debug sample 0.2% -> increase to 2% during canary -> 100% after 1 week if stable. feature-flag `auth_origin_tagging`.
Jun: alert rules: page if unique origin buckets >150 or if top-bucket token rate changes >25% vs baseline for 10m.
Alex: add retention: 30d hot, archive thereafter. watch cardinality cost.
ci-bot: "deploy queued: auth-proxy v2 -> canary 10%"
Lina: owners: Priya backend, Lina Console, Jun perf, Omar monitoring, Alex docs. reconvene in 48h to check sampled telemetry. Thanks all.
